workItems.objective: Assemble exact release evidence and prove every approved public OSS criterion before BusinessAcceptance and GitHub promotion.

included: Canonical suite, package, installed consumer, Windows matrix, governance, security, Desktop dogfood, traceability, integration, system, and protected-main evidence.
Record explicit exclusions for npm, Desktop plug-in, and hosted backend.
excluded: Self-approving the release, publishing before acceptance, or weakening failed evidence.

deliverables.description: Content-addressed release evidence set and BusinessAcceptance candidate.

dependency-hints.rationale: Acceptance requires the independent Desktop lifecycle run.
Acceptance requires exact automation and catalog evidence.
Acceptance requires the final public governance surface.
Acceptance requires the release-defining compatibility matrix.

checks.method: Evaluate every approved criterion against exact evidence digests, reject stale or missing proof, and generate a bounded BusinessAcceptance request without performing promotion.
checks.successCriteria: Every approved release criterion has current evidence and no unsupported distribution or product claim remains.

required-evidence.description: Every approved release criterion has current evidence and no unsupported distribution or product claim remains.

workItems.objective: Use the installed DevRelay tarball through ChatGPT Desktop on Windows to build and verify a separate minimal software project end to end.

included: Run the full released lifecycle with real artifacts, gates, checkpoints, traceability, execution, verification, integration, system verification, and acceptance.
Capture usability friction and human-readable run evidence.
excluded: A one-click Desktop plug-in, hosted backend, or self-verification using only DevRelay's repository.

deliverables.description: Independent minimal-project lifecycle run and exact evidence bundle.

dependency-hints.rationale: The independent dogfood must use the exact verified installed tarball.

checks.method: Create a clean minimal project, invoke every applicable released module and gate, verify produced software, then replay checkpoints and inspect traceability and the lifecycle report.
checks.successCriteria: A ChatGPT Desktop Windows session can use only the installed tarball and GitHub-source docs to produce verified working software with complete evidence.

required-evidence.description: A ChatGPT Desktop Windows session can use only the installed tarball and GitHub-source docs to produce verified working software with complete evidence.

workItems.objective: Provide deterministic GitHub verification and release automation without adding npm publication.

included: Pinned verification, dependency review, CodeQL, scorecard, and GitHub-source release workflows.
Generate release catalog and checksums from exact source and package bytes.
excluded: npm publish, unpinned third-party actions, or workflow-owned business acceptance.

deliverables.description: Pinned GitHub Actions and release evidence automation.

dependency-hints.rationale: Catalog and release evidence include the final governance surface.
Release automation must require the release-defining Windows evidence.

checks.method: Validate workflow syntax, action pins, permission boundaries, event routing, catalog/checksum freshness, and absence of registry publication operations.
checks.successCriteria: GitHub automation validates and packages exact source deterministically while all release authority remains downstream of lifecycle gates.

required-evidence.description: GitHub automation validates and packages exact source deterministically while all release authority remains downstream of lifecycle gates.

workItems.objective: Complete the Apache-2.0, DCO, community, support, and security surface for the public repository.

included: License, notice, DCO, contribution, governance, conduct, support, security-contact, ownership, issue, PR, and dependency-policy files.
Use garrett.audet@gmail.com as the public security contact.
excluded: CLA enforcement, private vulnerability contents, or a hosted community portal.

deliverables.description: Complete public OSS governance and security document set.

checks.method: Validate required files, metadata, contact values, DCO instructions, links, and release-catalog inclusion against the exact candidate.
checks.successCriteria: A GitHub user can understand license, contribution, governance, support, and private vulnerability reporting without unsupported claims.

required-evidence.description: A GitHub user can understand license, contribution, governance, support, and private vulnerability reporting without unsupported claims.

workItems.objective: Make the installable tarball faithfully expose every public package subpath declared by package.json.

included: Derive fixed and wildcard export inventory from package.json.
Include the missing ArchitectureDiscovery module and plug-in resources in the package.
excluded: Publishing to npm or adding a hosted distribution service.

deliverables.description: Export-derived package inventory, corrected package metadata, and exact tarball contents.

dependency-hints.rationale: The tarball must expose the complete released WorkExecution runtime, not only its contracts.

checks.method: Pack the candidate, expand every fixed and wildcard export, install it into a clean consumer, and import or parse every public subpath.
checks.successCriteria: The exact GitHub-source tarball installs without registry publication and every declared public export resolves from installed bytes.

required-evidence.description: The exact GitHub-source tarball installs without registry publication and every declared public export resolves from installed bytes.

workItems.objective: Verify and enforce main as the protected default branch before public release promotion.

included: Query default branch, rulesets or protection, required checks, review expectations, and repository security settings.
Bind host-owned evidence to the exact promotion request.
excluded: Encoding GitHub settings as source truth or bypassing owner-only repository controls.

dependency-hints.rationale: Protected main requires the final named checks and workflow set.

checks.method: Read GitHub repository settings, compare them to policy, apply owner-authorized settings when permitted, and capture the resulting immutable receipt.
checks.successCriteria: main is the default protected branch with the required release checks, and any owner-only gap is explicit before promotion.

required-evidence.description: main is the default protected branch with the required release checks, and any owner-only gap is explicit before promotion.

workItems.objective: Make Windows Node 22 and Node 24 the release-defining package and installed-consumer verification matrix.

included: Canonical verification, exact package inspection, isolated install, public export exercise, and deterministic negative export fixtures.
Preserve matrix results as exact release evidence.
excluded: Treating non-Windows CI as a substitute for the Windows release gate.

deliverables.description: Windows Node 22/24 package and installed-consumer verification suite.

dependency-hints.rationale: Installed verification consumes the exact corrected tarball and export inventory.

checks.method: Run canonical and clean installed-consumer gates on Windows under Node 22 and Node 24, including invalid, duplicate, missing, and escaping export fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Every supported Windows/Node job passes against the same tarball identity and every failure mode is deterministic.

required-evidence.description: Every supported Windows/Node job passes against the same tarball identity and every failure mode is deterministic.

workItems.objective: Implement the complete provider-neutral WorkExecution Core path declared by the released module contract.

included: Validate exact baselines, readiness, assignment, binding, policy, and repository identity before executor entry.
Checkpoint exact raw executor bytes, replay with zero calls, and assemble only ExecutionAttempt, ChangeSetDraft, and ExecutionEvidenceBundle candidate outputs.
Export the runtime and cover drift, permission, substitution, failure, interruption, retry, and replay paths.
excluded: Selecting a specialist, scheduling work, enforcing the host sandbox, verifying a change, integrating it, or creating completion facts.

deliverables.description: Released WorkExecution input guard, frontier validator, binding validator, checkpoint controller, result assembler, and orchestration API.

checks.method: Run focused positive and negative runtime tests proving exact readiness, binding, checkpoint, replay, output, retry, and no-downstream-authority behavior.
checks.successCriteria: A host can invoke one exact ready work item through the installed provider-neutral runtime and receive only validated candidate execution artifacts with byte-identical zero-call replay.

required-evidence.description: A host can invoke one exact ready work item through the installed provider-neutral runtime and receive only validated candidate execution artifacts with byte-identical zero-call replay.
